description.en: Redis in-memory data store (cache, queues, sessions)
description.id: Penyimpanan data in-memory Redis (cache, antrean, sesi)

config_templates.redis.conf:
bind 127.0.0.1
port {{port}}
protected-mode yes
daemonize no
dir "{{data}}"
pidfile "{{run}}/redis.pid"
logfile "{{logs}}/redis-{{version}}.log"
save 3600 1 300 100 60 10000
appendonly no
